name: copyas
description: Copy Claude's last reply to the clipboard for Slack, Teams, Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Jira, email, Google Docs, GitHub and more, as rich text or the right markup, free of terminal artifacts.

default_format.title: Default copy format
default_format.description: Destination used by /copyas when none is given (rich = email and documents)

rich.title: Rich clipboard
rich.description: Put formatted rich text (HTML) on the clipboard for Slack, Jira Cloud, email and docs, when a tool on this machine can carry it

save_copy.title: Save a copy to ~/.claude/copyas
save_copy.description: Also write the converted text (and HTML) to ~/.claude/copyas/last.* so it survives a failed clipboard write
